_about: Enemy tiers for Forge Campaign, read by forge.campaign.ai.EnemyTiers. An enemy's tier is its entry under 'enemies' (by name in enemies.json); else Boss if enemies.json marks it a boss; else Elite if its life is at least rules.eliteMinLife; else Grunt. Each tier sets an AI profile (res/ai), a simulation mode (none, hybrid, full) a time budget per decision (budgetMs) and per game turn (turnBudgetMs, then the heuristic AI plays the rest of the turn), in milliseconds.
_tuning: Elite overrides (2026-10-16): these bosses' upstream effects (the Hydra's heads, Garruk's second phase, Kiora's Tentacles, Slimefoot's Fungi) dominate whatever their life; the Boss tier's full simulation added turns of up to 45 s for no difference in strength (scripts/boss_tune.py, region_bench.py).
